name: Palm sugar
summary: Đường thốt nốt is the sugar of the thốt nốt palms on the plain around Châu Đốc. The same trees give palm juice and bánh bò thốt nốt, and the sugar is the gift people carry home.
origin: The plains around Châu Đốc and the Bảy Núi, where people have long made palm juice, palm sugar, and bánh bò thốt nốt.
howToEat: Carry a cake of it home, with the fruit, quả thốt nốt.
The jelly from the fruit is chè thốt nốt, a separate bowl.
where: Gift stalls in Châu Đốc. The palms stand along the roads between the center and the sights.
seoTitle: Duong thot not in Chau Doc
seoDescription: Đường thốt nốt is palm sugar from the thốt nốt palms around Châu Đốc, the sweet gift to carry home.
